This removes %1$d leftover temporary files (%2$s) and %3$d completed records whose files are gone.\n\nValid videos, gallery copies and the resume points of paused or running tasks are kept. It re-checks before deleting and skips anything that changed.
Temporary files hold download resume points and merge fragments; files still referenced by a task are kept. To free space used by saved videos, delete them in Saved.
